response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users lose access to reserves data and supplier payment reports after a system reset, disrupting weekly financial reporting. I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap pages: 'Reporting navigation' (Shortcut 4137 and its Notion roadmap counterpart) covers navigation shortcuts for claim reports but not data loss or post-reset access; 'Bulk upload documents' (4127, completed) is about document uploads; 'Supplier address fields' (4136, in progress) concerns address formats and validation; and 'Payment history improvements' (4130, completed) refines the payment history view without addressing system resets or reporting regeneration. No completed story solves the same problem, and no roadmap item covers restoring data access and supplier payment reports after a system reset. Therefore, the core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
